use_ParamSchedulerHook: use ParamSchedulerHook to update learning rate and momentum hyperparameters during training
call_after_train_iter: call after_train_iter to step non-epoch-based param schedulers after each training iteration
call_after_train_epoch: call after_train_epoch to step epoch-based param schedulers after each training epoch
call_after_val_epoch: call after_val_epoch to step schedulers needing validation metrics after each val epoch
register_ParamSchedulerHook: register ParamSchedulerHook with HOOKS registry to manage optimizer hyperparameter scheduling
